bias.en: Rebound · slipped under the 200-day, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 200 日均线，守住 10 日均线

read.en: TSMC fell 1.7% on Nov 13 to $398.73, trading $391.50–408.08. It is above the falling 10-day ($393.0) and below the rising 5-day ($400.5) and 200-day ($403.1) and the falling 30-day ($422.8) and 100-day ($425.3). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($353.79), and RSI is 45.3.
read.zh: 台积电 11月13日下跌 1.7%，收于 $398.73，盘中区间 $391.50–408.08。股价位于下行的 10 日均线（$393.0）上方，上行的 5 日（$400.5）和 200 日均线（$403.1）以及下行的 30 日（$422.8）和 100 日均线（$425.3）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$353.79），RSI 为 45.3。

read.en: The close lost the 200-day and the $400.2 Nov 10 high, now resistance; the $391.50 low dipped under the 10-day but the close held it. Resistance is $400.2–403.1 (5 and 200-day), then $405.5–411.8 (Nov 11–12 levels) and $414.8–416.8. Support is $391.5–396.5 (Nov 13 low, 10-day), then $387.2–388.6 and $375.4–380.3. A close above $403.1 would target $408–412; below $391.5, $387–389.
